name: Catalog Editor
description: Compose immutable CAT snapshots with explicit source precedence, identifier conflict review and per-object orbital-state source selection; integrate the composed catalog with every source's products: identity links tested on trajectories, the product chosen by measured error, its covariance and label, merged maneuvers.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Version 1 composition recipe: ordered source snapshots, native keys, overrides, state-source IDs, asOf and maximum age.

wildcardJustification.detail: Version 1 composition recipe: ordered source snapshots, native keys, overrides, state-source IDs, asOf and maximum age. Module configuration/decision metadata, never persisted as an observation.

inputPorts.description: Version 1 composition recipe: ordered source snapshots, native keys, overrides, state-source IDs, asOf and maximum age.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical size-prefixed CAT streams, one per recipe layer in the same order.

inputPorts.description: Canonical size-prefixed CAT streams, one per recipe layer in the same order.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Selected CAT records with original bytes preserved; unresolved identifier conflicts are excluded.

outputPorts.description: Selected CAT records with original bytes preserved; unresolved identifier conflicts are excluded.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Composition decisions and source/frame provenance for the editor.

wildcardJustification.detail: Composition decisions and source/frame provenance for the editor. Module configuration/decision metadata, never persisted as an observation.

outputPorts.description: Composition decisions and source/frame provenance for the editor.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Version 1 integration recipe: asOf, the identity links with their thresholds, the selection policy with its measured table, and the maneuver policy.

wildcardJustification.detail: Version 1 integration recipe: asOf, the identity links with their thresholds, the selection policy with its measured table, and the maneuver policy. Module configuration/decision metadata, never persisted as an observation.

inputPorts.description: Version 1 integration recipe: asOf, the identity links with their thresholds, the selection policy with its measured table, and the maneuver policy.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The composed catalog: canonical size-prefixed CAT records, each object once (the output of compose, or one snapshot).

inputPorts.description: The composed catalog: canonical size-prefixed CAT records, each object once (the output of compose, or one snapshot).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Normalized common-grid OEM trajectories of the identity candidates, one size-prefixed record per candidate in the recipe's order.

inputPorts.description: Normalized common-grid OEM trajectories of the identity candidates, one size-prefixed record per candidate in the recipe's order.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Every source's element sets, canonical size-prefixed OMM records, each naming its source in USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS SOURCE_ID.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Every source's states and covariance with the covariance label, canonical size-prefixed OCM records, each naming its source in USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS SOURCE_ID.

inputPorts.description: Every source's maneuvers, canonical size-prefixed MNV records, each tagged source:<id>.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The input objects in order, original bytes kept; MANEUVERABLE is set where the maneuver history shows a maneuver.
